headline: Who is considered poor in Uzbekistan and how many are there? Labor Ministry explains
summary: According to the labour ministry, 1.4 million citizens in Uzbekistan were living in poverty as of October 1. Households with per capita monthly income below 715,000 soum are classed as poor.
why: Poverty levels indicate household purchasing power and the scale of social support spending, which matter for consumer demand and fiscal policy in Uzbekistan.
